create_hubert_dataset: create a HubertDataset instance from an audio manifest and label files for fairseq training
load_audio_manifest: load an audio manifest file filtering samples by min and max size thresholds
collate_audio_samples: collate a batch of audio samples with padding or cropping to a uniform size
verify_label_lengths: verify audio and label durations match within a tolerance for a given label rate
postprocess_wav_tensor: postprocess a wav tensor by converting to mono and applying layer normalization
